decisions.reason: After surviving its first full year with a dedicated product page, this track spotlight looks sufficiently validated and fits the firm's design-led modular core, so the option value of keeping it remains high and the case for withdrawal is weak.

The ceiling luminaire also remained prominently presented through 2024, which suggests acceptable market traction in a growing industry and supports keeping it as a now less-uncertain but still valuable portfolio option.

As a 2024 launch with its own page, this flexible spotlight is still in the early learning phase, and because it closely matches the firm's emphasis on adaptable lighting systems it is worth keeping while demand evidence develops.

This multi-outlet canopy is a system-complement product whose strategic value includes supporting wider luminaire sales, so with low apparent downside and unresolved upside the firm would likely keep it on the market.

The low-voltage canopy is newer and somewhat more specialized, which raises uncertainty, but as a modular accessory aligned with the firm's system logic it still looks worth retaining for another year.

Because the round glass track luminaires were only mentioned rather than given a full standalone presentation, they appear to be the weakest and most tentative option, yet their recent launch and likely limited carrying cost still favor keeping them for one more year rather than dropping immediately.
